note: Data tables as a tenant would hold them under Detection > Data tables. Google is replacing reference lists with data tables: existing lists are migrated automatically and legacy reference lists retire in July 2027. A table has named, typed columns; a query names one column as %table.column in the same three forms a list takes (in, in regex, in cidr). This trainer bundles the station's tables; nothing here is created or edited.

tables.name: station_allowlist
tables.description: The migrated sponsor allowlist, one row per name the station's machines may resolve, with where each name came from. Read the source column to the end: two rows came from the week-one mail log, not from a contract.

tables.name: privileged_accounts
tables.description: Accounts allowed to run as another account on station hosts, which account they may run as, and who granted it. The migrated form of admin_accounts.

tables.name: gateway_blocks
tables.description: Ranges the gateway blocks, why, and since when. The migrated form of blocked_ranges, with the reason beside the range.

tables.name: lookalike_shapes
tables.description: Shapes of lookalike sender domains and the real name each one imitates. The migrated form of lookalike_patterns; the second column says what the pattern is for.
